description: Two hooks, each a no-op unless a run of this kit is actually in flight. On Bash: refuse to merge a pull request, to force-push, and to push to the default branch. On Stop: refuse to end a turn while this session's own run file is still mid-step, and close the session of an `epic` that has finished, which nothing else closes. Outside a run neither has an opinion, and neither ever fires in the owner's own sessions.
